Maya (PM): Large retail deal wants onboarding tied to reserved-capacity SLAs + a firm migration window. Need a crisp checklist for sales.
Ravi (Product): Suggest two lanes: Reserved (dedicated GPUs, SLA + perf guarantees) and Hosted (best-effort). Need acceptance gates for Reserved.
Ana (Eng): For Reserved acceptance we should require: 1) perf: p95 <= 250ms at seq=128 under agreed QPS, 2) benched under replay + synthetic, 3) artifact compatibility (quant/format).
Lee (SRE): Also require stability: 7-day canary with >=99.9% availability (exclude customer network), plus cache-warm metrics: cold-start < 5% and kv-hit >= 80%.
Ravi (Product): Migration terms: 90-day notice before deprecation, and offer a paid 'compat shim' (30 days) as migration-assist. Legal wants default pin TTL and renewal flow.
Maya (PM): Propose pin TTL tiers: Enterprise 180d default, SMB/Startup 90d opt-down. Add emergency rollback clause for security incidents.
Ana (Eng): Bench harness notes: will support replay runs and synthetic stress. Example: `./bench --model=/m/customerX/v1 --seq=128 --qps=150 --warmup=120s` -> outputs p50/p95, tps, kv-hit.
Lee (SRE): I'll draft GPU->QPS sizing templates (1/4/8 A100 equiv) and a guidance page for autoscale bursts + multi-region egress.
Ravi (Product): Product to write contract language for 90d notice + paid shim option. Include pin TTL table and renewal checkbox in onboarding flow.
Maya (PM): Action items: Eng bench spec (Ana) due Tue EOD; SRE sizing + cost delta for shim (Lee) due Thu; Product draft contract + one-pager (Ravi) due Fri.
comm-bot: note: sales-onepager template pushed -> docs/sales/onboard-reserved-lane v1 at 2026-03-25T14:00Z
Maya (PM): Thanks — I'll assemble the one-pager and post to #sales when ready.
